evidence.note: draftToRestore's only Some write is the O.getOrElse thunk. Effect Option.getOrElse evaluates that thunk only on None; it is reached only after currentDraftOccupied.pipe(O.orElse) also yielded None, so the write always happens with occupied still None.

currentDraftOccupied is a one-shot O.map of draftAtom to Option<true> before A.filter; it is never reassigned. O.orElse at 1028 is lazy, so occupied Some never evaluates the restore probe or the getOrElse writer. restore Some therefore implies occupied None for the rest of the synchronous block.

notes: Correction of r26-agents-workspace D1. Reachable observations: 00 init/no not_persisted restore, 10 occupied snapshot with restore stuck None, 01 restore selected while occupied stays None. Both-Some is not an observation in this block. Sequential A.filter only moves 00->01; it cannot create 11. Distinct payloads (composer draft vs selected fallback) remain; presence bits are exclusive.
